query:
SELECT workspace_id, elem->>'git_repo_resource_path' AS "repo_path!",
                  elem->'auto_pull'->>'webhook_url' AS webhook_url,
                  elem->'auto_pull'->>'webhook_error' AS webhook_error
           FROM workspace_settings, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(git_sync->'repositories') AS elem
           WHERE jsonb_typeof(git_sync->'repositories') = 'array'
             AND elem->>'git_repo_resource_path' IS NOT NULL
             AND (elem->'auto_pull'->'webhook_id' IS NOT NULL
                  OR elem->'auto_pull'->>'webhook_error' IS NOT NULL)
